## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and module ID/version. Link the issue and the
human approval of the exact specification revision or digest.

## Contracts

List public API, dependency, permission and migration changes. Explain compatibility.

## Evidence

List actual commands and results, including PostgreSQL and disposable consumer
checks. Link the source-bound review record. State skipped or unavailable checks.
For screens, include rendered screenshots with synthetic data.

## Release source

- [ ] Module/package/spec versions agree and existing migrations are unchanged.
- [ ] Required checks pass and review matches the final source digest.
- [ ] New immutable artifact is included; existing artifacts are untouched.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime state or local dependency overrides are committed.
- [ ] Public registry publication is left to maintainers after acceptance.
